title: 14 Killed in Culiacán and Mazatlán; Six Young People Abducted in Eastern Culiacán
detail: Posta counted at least 14 homicides across Culiacán (six) and Mazatlán on Oct 27, while UnoTV headlined 12 dead and 8 abducted; tolls differ by outlet. Around 21:30 armed men in at least four vehicles took six young people from the Villa del Real subdivision, El Barrio sector, eastern Culiacán. A human head was found in a cooler near the Mazatlán Municipal Palace. Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch travelled to Sinaloa on Oct 28 to review the strategy.
